## Activity

During October 2019, Hill Counties Health Centre completed 60 captures. This activity provides the basis for reviewing image quality and grading performance for the month. The recorded workload was assessed alongside the number of images that could not be graded and the outcomes requiring referral.

## Image quality

Of the images captured, 3 were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 5.0 per cent. This indicates that most captures were suitable for assessment, while a small proportion could not be used for grading. The ungradable captures should continue to be monitored as part of routine site operations and quality assurance.

## Grading

Grading identified 8 referable results. The median lag between capture and grading was 1 day. This reflects the typical time taken for images to progress from capture to a grading outcome during October 2019. Overall, the site recorded 60 captures, with 3 ungradable images and 8 referable results.
